column_occupancy.denominator: corresponding occupancy_denominator; ~ excluded and explicitly counted
column_occupancy.formula: residue rows / rows with usable column geometry and symbol other than ~
column_occupancy.interpretation: insert-column occupancy is rendering occupancy and does not imply homologous correspondence

deleted_model_positions.formula: count - . _ gaps at RF model positions; ~ is missing, not deletion

insert_state_residues.formula: count residues between first and last RF model columns at nonmodel positions

match_state_residues.formula: count residue symbols at RF model positions

missing_model_positions.formula: count native ~ at RF model positions

model_length.formula: supplied profile.length checked against RF model-column count; otherwise RF count

nonresidue_model_positions.formula: count native * nonresidue symbols at RF model positions

original_length.formula: supplied length validated against supplied sequence, or its actual symbol length

posterior_bins.population: corresponding native PP residue or PP_cons model-column population
posterior_bins.uncertainty: interval endpoints retained, upper endpoint open unless all bins are *

posterior_lower_mean.uncertainty: quantization_interval; not exact posterior or annotation correctness

posterior_upper_mean.uncertainty: quantization_interval; not exact posterior or annotation correctness

pp_cons.denominator: native total unknown unless complete membership/PP supplied; observed denominator separately retained
pp_cons.formula: native bin of the mean posterior over newly aligned match-state residues with PP; inherited traces excluded

retained_residues.formula: count ASCII letters in the native aligned row; gaps, ~ and nonresidue * excluded

summary.formula: counts of supplied records and explicit populations; no score aggregation or independence claim
summary.missing: missing output differs from a terminated empty Stockholm record

terminal_unaligned_residues.formula: count retained residues before first or after last RF model column; excludes residues removed by --trim

trimmed_residues.formula: original_length - retained_residues when trim is true and lengths/sequence compatible; zero when trim is false and join compatible
